column1: # The service versions Kapelos runs for each Magento release, from Adobe's system requirements for its two newest patches.
# In each column the first version is the one Kapelos runs, one both patches support, and the rest are the others either supports.
# kapelos adopt runs the first; kapelos doctor accepts any of them, matching a listed version and anything under it, so 3 accepts 3.6.0.
# 2.4.9 lists MariaDB 12.3 on premises and 12.3 or 11.8 in the cloud; Kapelos runs 11.8, the long-term release.
# 2.4.4 lists no Valkey or Varnish, so it gets the versions its successors use.
